watch.en: Cook only a few seconds in a large amount of boiling water.
watch.de: Nur wenige Sekunden in reichlich kochendem Wasser garen.

why.en: It softens firm foods, sets colours and loosens skins for peeling.
why.de: Es macht festes Gargut weicher, fixiert Farben und löst Häute zum Schälen.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3.10 Vegetable Nutrition, Storage and Preparation, section Blanching and Parboiling
sources.sentence: Blanching is the partial cooking of foods in a large amount of boiling water for a very short time, usually only a few seconds.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3.10 Vegetable Nutrition, Storage and Preparation, section Blanching and Parboiling
sources.sentence: blanching is used to remove strong or bitter flavors, soften firm foods, set colors or loosen skins for peeling.
